meta.title: Send Bulk Counter Offer when the event moves from live to live2
gaps: Starting from a live RFQ with no bids
Waiting for or verifying the RFQ's actual live2 state caused by bidding ending or award submission
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Starting from a live RFQ with no bids; Waiting for or verifying the RFQ's actual live2 state caused by bidding ending or award submission

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Verify the bulk counter-offer action is greyed out with only one existing bid and that its explanatory tooltip is present.
Open the RFQ Participants list so a second vendor can be given a surrogate bid.
Submit a bid for another invited vendor to create the second response.
Confirm the second vendor's surrogate bid was accepted.
Verify the bulk counter-offer action is now clickable after the second bid.
